bagPolicy.summary: Small clutch purses and fanny packs 6 x 9 inches or smaller do not need to be clear and may have no more than one pocket. Other bags larger than 6 x 9 inches must be clear and smaller than 12 x 6 x 12 inches. Empty hydration packs are allowed within the festival policy.
allowed: small clutch/fanny packs up to 6 x 9 inches
clear bags smaller than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched and the festival says the policy is subject to change.

parking.note: Parking options around Lollapalooza in Chicago may include nearby public parking lots and garages. Prices can vary, and it is advisable to arrive early to secure a spot. Consider using public transportation or rideshare services to avoid parking hassles.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Lollapalooza's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Chicago Park District offers a variety of concessionaires providing unique dining and recreational opportunities. These include sit-down meals, quick snacks, and rental services. Concessions typically operate from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Lollapalooza, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Lollapalooza's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Lollapalooza. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Lollapalooza. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
